entries.text: Another day, another round of battle study! Osu!\nLet’s get right to it![VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: class_e_03_battle_01

entries.text: Last time, we learned about Tera Raid Battles!\nDid any of you have a chance to try them out?[VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: class_e_03_battle_02

entries.text: Tera Pokémon are super strong! And the more\ndifficult ones will use an even tougher tactic that\r\nyou’ll need to deal with.[VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: class_e_03_battle_03

entries.text: I’m talking about their [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Tera Shield[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]![VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: class_e_03_battle_04

entries.text: What happens while a Pokémon has its\nTera Shield up, you ask?[VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: class_e_03_battle_05

entries.text: Well, it’ll take WAAAY less damage, for one![VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: class_e_03_battle_06

entries.text: It has a big effect on morale, too![VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: class_e_03_battle_07

entries.text: When Trainers see that shield go up, they feel\ndoomed—like there’s no way to win the battle![VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: class_e_03_battle_08

entries.text: So, here’s a question for you![VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: class_e_03_battle_09

entries.text: If the Pokémon you’re battling puts up its Tera\nShield, what should you do?[VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: class_e_03_battle_10

entries.text: Close your eyes and give in
entries.label: class_e_03_select_01

entries.text: Call your parents
entries.label: class_e_03_select_02

entries.text: Terastallize and attack it
entries.label: class_e_03_select_03

entries.text: What?! Don’t just accept defeat! You should be\nable to find a way out of this predicament if you\r\nkeep on fighting![VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: class_e_03_battle_answer_01

entries.text: What?! Don’t call your family to tell them you’re\nabout to lose! You should be able to find a way\r\nout of this predicament if you keep on fighting![VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: class_e_03_battle_answer_02

entries.text: That’s right! You’re a regular Tera Raid Battle\nmaster, aren’t you, new kid?[VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: class_e_03_battle_answer_03

entries.text: Regular attacks don’t work so well against\nPokémon that have their Tera Shield up.[VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: class_e_03_battle_11

entries.text:
But having your Pokémon Terastallize is an
effective method to overcome that issue!\c
A Terastallized Pokémon will do more damage
to shielded Pokémon—especially if it uses moves
that match its Tera Type![VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: class_e_03_battle_12

entries.text: Dealing enough damage to a Pokémon with its\nTera Shield up can destroy the shield and break\r\nthe Pokémon’s stance![VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: class_e_03_battle_13

entries.text: This means that it’s important to properly time\nyour Terastallizing in Tera Raid Battles.[VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: class_e_03_battle_14

entries.text: In conclusion![VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: class_e_03_battle_15

entries.text: As they say, fight fire with fire and Tera\nPokémon with Tera Pokémon![VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: class_e_03_battle_16

entries.text: Be sure to work together with your teammates to\nsmash through your opponent’s Tera Shield![VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: class_e_03_battle_17

entries.text: Aw, man! I was just about to suggest we do some\nhands-on practice to really drive the point home,\r\nbut I guess we’re out of time once again...[VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: class_e_03_battle_18

entries.text: Next class will be our midterm exam! Aim for a\nperfect score! Osu! Osu![VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: class_e_03_battle_19
